_comment: First run — empty store: TOP catalog rows at their defaults, tail slots are placeholders, no folds beyond More options, no Advanced.
Customized shared rows (A1 CUSTOMIZED): reset buttons materialize in the 28px tail slot.
Per-app overrides of shared keys (A3), demo-world groups: bill-calendar pays in EUR, habit-streaks polls slower.
Duplicate (group,key): last in snapshot order wins — the app folds both into one week_start=sunday row.
Type mismatch (A7): dashboard declares show_greeting as boolean — the stored string renders as a fix-or-delete raw row in its section.
Reserved row (A5): security:* keys render read-only under Advanced — only the Permissions pane (security_set) writes them.
Orphan group (A6): sunset-tracker was removed; its stored settings surface under Advanced for cleanup.
